note: The console's Entra resource (operator_ui.case_console --entra-resource; the live check session.employee_recorded reads this file unless PLX_CONSOLE_ENTRA_RESOURCE names another). Identifiers only, never a secret. Sign-in uses the existing app registration with its delegated scope; app-only tokens are refused. A value is committed only where committed repository content states it (sources); every other field is a typed unset naming its later ask: the resource URI and the tenant's JWKS file wait for the hosting VM, and the console's redirect URI (on the app registration, not in this file) with them (docs/decisions/2026-10-20-a9-console-signin-proof.md).
